title: Connectivity of the slice filtration
summary: Using methods similar to Morel's stable connectivity theorem, we prove that, over an arbitrary field, the Tate truncation functors $f_{0/n}$ preserve motivic connectivity of $ S^1$-spectra. An analogous result for complexes yields a Hurewicz theorem for the $L^{p,n}$- and $L_{bir}^n$-localizations over perfect fields. Over such fields, we establish a stronger connectivity property for categories of correspondences, showing that $f_n^\mathcal{C}$ preserves connectivity of motivic spectra with $\mathcal{C}$-transfers, whenever $\mathcal{C}$ satisfies cancellation.
